name: Four Seasons Hotel Macao, Cotai Strip
positioning: Luxury hotel on the Cotai Strip in Macau with five pools, a spa and Michelin-starred Chinese dining
best_for: Families who want pools and a non-gaming hotel on the Cotai Strip
Travelers who want a covered walkway to the Venetian Macau shops

facts.text: Four Seasons Hotel Macao has 20 stories.
The hotel is surrounded by the glamour and buzz of the Cotai Strip.
Macau International Airport is 1.5 kilometres and a five-minute drive from the hotel.
Zi Yat Heen is the hotel's Michelin-starred Chinese restaurant.
Belcanção is an all-day buffet restaurant.
Splash is a poolside restaurant serving salads, burgers or freshly baked pizzas.
The hotel has five swimming pools.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The press fact sheet describes the hotel as a family-friendly, non-gaming hotel.

highlights.text: The Shoppes at Four Seasons and Shoppes at Venetian Macau are connected to the hotel via a covered walkway.
The outdoor pools include a tropical, lagoon-style pool.
Two shallow pools are described as perfect for kids.
The spa's Blissful Sensation ritual uses a scrub salt mixed from the essence of port wine.
Kids For All Seasons has specially trained staff entertain the kids.

considerations.text: The Cotai Strip is described as a world-class gaming destination, home to 41 fast-paced casinos and themed hotels.
Macau's historic centre is a 15-minute drive from the hotel.
The swimming pools are open 8:00 am to 8:00 pm.
WhataHotel notes the casino-resort atmosphere may feel overwhelming for travelers seeking a quieter, leisure-focused retreat.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
